```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-measurement-detailed
%%| fig-cap: "A richer depiction of the process of measurement involving an observer, some procedure, and an apparatus or measurement instrument."
%%| fig.width: 800

flowchart LR
  O[Observer] ---> M[Measurement]
  P[Procedure] ---> M
  D[Apparatus] ---> M
  A((World)) --> M
  M --> B[Data]
```

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-hard-round

  B --> C{Decision}
```

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-measurement
```
